device.category: 4-note paraphonic semi-modular analogue synthesizer, 49 keys, with stereo analogue delay, arpeggiator and sequencer
device.based_on: Moog modular circuits: oscillators from the Minimoog Voyager (921 lineage), mixer after the CP3, filters after the 904A, envelopes after the 911, VCAs after the 902, delay after the Moog 500 Series analog delay; released 2019.

sources.title: Moog Matriarch Owner's Manual
sources.note: Every module with its patch points and normals, paraphony, rear panel, global settings, MIDI CC and SysEx documentation, specifications.

architecture.polyphony_mode: 1-note mono, 2-note paraphonic (Osc 1+2, Osc 3+4) or 4-note paraphonic (one oscillator per note), shared filter and VCA path
architecture.patch_memory_note: No sound memory. Twelve sequences (three banks of four, up to 256 steps) and global settings are retained.
architecture.summary: Four VCOs (triangle, saw, square, narrow pulse; 16'-2'; Osc 2-4 detune and hard-sync to the previous one) with pitch, linear FM and PWM inputs; white noise and a rear instrument input into a DC-coupled mixer with per-oscillator gates for paraphony. Two ladder filters share CUTOFF (SPACING offsets VCF 1) and run HP/LP in series, LP/LP in stereo or HP/LP in parallel. Two ADSRs, two VCAs (AMP ENV, SPLIT or DRONE), stereo BBD delay. Modulation oscillator (six waves, to 1.3 kHz) with noise and S/H outputs, plus a separate triangle/square LFO, three voltage-controlled inverting attenuators and two mults. Arpeggiator and sequencer. Plays without patching; 90 jacks extend it.

modules.name: Keyboard, LHC and voice assigner
modules.description: 49-key Fatar with velocity and channel aftertouch (not hard-wired: use the rear jacks or MIDI). Assigns notes to oscillators by VOICE MODE and opens each oscillator's mixer gate. Glide, octave transpose, wheels.

modules.name: Oscillator pitch inputs
modules.description: The four PITCH IN jacks chain: a signal at Osc 1 PITCH IN reaches Osc 1-4, until a later PITCH IN jack is patched, which takes over from there on.

modules.name: Oscillator 1
modules.description: VCO: triangle, sawtooth, square or narrow pulse; 16'-2'. Sets the reference pitch for Osc 2-4.

modules.name: Oscillator 2
modules.description: VCO: triangle, sawtooth, square or narrow pulse; 16'-2'. FREQUENCY detunes ±7 semitones from Osc 1; hard sync to Osc 1.

modules.name: Oscillator 3
modules.description: VCO: triangle, sawtooth, square or narrow pulse; 16'-2'. FREQUENCY detunes ±7 semitones from Osc 1; hard sync to Osc 2.

modules.name: Oscillator 4
modules.description: VCO: triangle, sawtooth, square or narrow pulse; 16'-2'. FREQUENCY detunes ±7 semitones from Osc 1; hard sync to Osc 3.

modules.name: White noise
modules.description: White noise with a 1-pole high-pass colour filter (global setting); into the mixer and to NOISE OUT.

modules.name: Instrument input
modules.description: Instrument-level input with +20 dB gain, straight into the mixer.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: Five levels (noise, Osc 1-4) plus the instrument input; DC coupled; overdrives above 11 o'clock. Oscillator channels have gates that mute unplayed oscillators in paraphonic modes.

modules.name: Cutoff inputs
modules.description: CUTOFF 1 IN is normalled to CUTOFF 2 IN, so one patch moves both filters until CUTOFF 2 IN is used.

modules.name: VCF 1
modules.description: Moog 24 dB/oct ladder, high-pass (series, parallel) or low-pass (stereo); cutoff = CUTOFF + SPACING; resonance 1 self-oscillates above about 3 o'clock.

modules.name: VCF 2
modules.description: Moog 24 dB/oct ladder, always low-pass; fed from the mixer or from VCF 1 (series).

modules.name: Filter routing
modules.description: Sums VCF 1 and VCF 2 in parallel mode; passes the routed filter outputs to the VCAs.

modules.name: Filter envelope
modules.description: ADSR, 2 ms-10 s stages, 0 to +8 V; also controls VCA 1 in SPLIT. ENV END OUT goes high when the envelope finishes.

modules.name: Amplitude envelope
modules.description: ADSR, 2 ms-10 s; controls both VCAs in AMP ENV, VCA 2 in SPLIT.

modules.name: VCA 1
modules.description: Left channel VCA; level from an envelope (per VCA MODE) times VCA 1 CV IN, or the CV alone in DRONE.

modules.name: VCA 2
modules.description: Right channel VCA; level from an envelope (per VCA MODE) times VCA 2 CV IN, or the CV alone in DRONE.

modules.name: Internal references
modules.description: Default drone voltage normalled to VCA 1/2 CV IN in DRONE, and +8 V normalled to each attenuator input.

modules.name: Stereo delay
modules.description: Two BBD delays: 35-780 ms (longer by tap or patching), SPACING offsets Delay 1, feedback to self-oscillation, ping pong, sync or tap tempo; dark or bright tone.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: MIX crossfades dry VCA and wet delay per side; MAIN VOLUME to MAIN OUT L/R (L mono when R is unplugged); EURO OUT and headphones bypass MAIN VOLUME.

modules.name: Modulation oscillator
modules.description: 0.07 Hz-1.3 kHz; sine, sawtooth, ramp, square (uni or bipolar), staircase (stepped triangle at the arp clock) or smooth random. Routed by the mod wheel to pitch, cutoff and pulse width.

modules.name: Sample and hold
modules.description: Samples the noise at the start of each modulation cycle; no internal routing.

modules.name: Attenuator 1
modules.description: Inverting, voltage-controlled: centre fully attenuated, clockwise towards unity, anticlockwise inverted; +8 V normalled to the input (a DC source unpatched). Usable as a ring modulator.

modules.name: Attenuator 2
modules.description: Inverting, voltage-controlled: centre fully attenuated, clockwise towards unity, anticlockwise inverted; +8 V normalled to the input (a DC source unpatched). Usable as a ring modulator.

modules.name: Attenuator 3
modules.description: Inverting, voltage-controlled: centre fully attenuated, clockwise towards unity, anticlockwise inverted; +8 V normalled to the input (a DC source unpatched). Usable as a ring modulator.

modules.name: Mult 1
modules.description: Four unbuffered parallel jacks; also passively mixes outputs.

modules.name: Mult 2
modules.description: Four unbuffered parallel jacks; also passively mixes outputs.

modules.name: Patchable LFO
modules.description: Triangle and square at once, 0.07-520 Hz (about 620 Hz with CV).

modules.name: Arpeggiator / sequencer
modules.description: Arpeggiator (order, forward/backward, random; 1-3 octaves) and 12 sequences of up to 256 steps (up to four notes, rest, tie, up to 8 ratchets per step); 20-280 BPM, tap, MIDI or clock.

modules.name: Expression pedal
modules.description: Expression pedal (e.g. EP-3) scaled to 0-8 V at EXP CV OUT.

modules.name: Filter envelope amount
modules.description: ENVELOPE AMT knob plus ENV AMT IN; scales the filter envelope to both cutoffs.

indicators.label: rate LEDs
indicators.function: Flash at the modulation, LFO, arp/seq and delay rates; the delay LED is red, green (internal sync) or yellow (external sync).

indicators.label: button LEDs
indicators.function: Sync, multi trig, ping pong, sync/tap, play, hold, tap, rest, tie, ratchet; SYNC ENABLE blinks the selected global setting.

behaviours.name: Default signal path
behaviours.rule: Oscillators, noise and instrument input into the mixer, the filters (per FILTER MODE), the two VCAs (per VCA MODE), the stereo delay (MIX crossfades dry and wet), then the outputs. Patching a mixer, filter, VCA or delay input replaces its normal.

behaviours.name: Filter modes
behaviours.rule: Series: VCF 1 high-pass into VCF 2 low-pass (band-pass), mono to both VCAs. Stereo: both low-pass from the mixer, VCF 1 to VCA 1 (left), VCF 2 to VCA 2 (right). Parallel: VCF 1 high-pass and VCF 2 low-pass summed (notch), mono to both. CUTOFF moves both; SPACING offsets VCF 1.

behaviours.name: Paraphony
behaviours.rule: VOICE MODE 1: all four oscillators on one note. 2: first key Osc 1+2, second key Osc 3+4. 4: one oscillator per key, Osc 1 first after all keys are released. Mixer gates mute unused oscillators (and their external replacements). MULTI TRIG retriggers envelopes on every note; otherwise only after all keys are up.

behaviours.name: Chained normals
behaviours.rule: PITCH IN at Osc 1 reaches Osc 1-4 until a later PITCH IN is patched (a dead patch isolates). CUTOFF 1 IN reaches both filters until CUTOFF 2 IN is patched. FB CV IN reaches both delays until FB 2 CV IN is patched.

behaviours.name: Modulation
behaviours.rule: PITCH AMT (to all, 1&3 or 2&4), CUTOFF AMT and PULSE WIDTH AMT set maxima; the MOD wheel applies them. The S/H samples noise each cycle and has no internal routing. Velocity and aftertouch are not hard-wired: patch the rear jacks.

behaviours.name: VCA modes
behaviours.rule: AMP ENV: amp envelope on both. SPLIT: filter envelope on VCA 1 (left), amp envelope on VCA 2 (right). DRONE: a default voltage (or VCA CV IN, 0-8 V) holds the level without keys.

behaviours.name: Utilities
behaviours.rule: Each attenuator inverts anticlockwise, has a CV input, and outputs a DC level from its +8 V normal when nothing is patched; audio into INPUT and CV IN gives ring modulation. Mults are unbuffered and also mix outputs passively.

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator and sequencer
behaviours.rule: PLAY arms, a key starts (and transposes the sequence); HOLD latches (sustain when idle); TAP sets tempo. REC records steps of up to four notes with rests, ties and up to 8 ratchets; recording while stopped overwrites the sequence. 12 sequences, up to 256 steps, kept at power-off.

behaviours.name: Envelope looping
behaviours.rule: ENV END OUT goes high when an envelope finishes; patch it to TRIGGER IN for a looping envelope.

receives.note: 14-bit pairs: mod wheel 1:33, mod rate 3:35, glide 5:37, arp rate 8:40, noise filter 9:41, delay time 12:44, delay spacing 13:45, arp swing 14:46, arp gate length 15:47, Osc 2-4 frequency 16:48-18:50

source_inconsistencies: The specifications describe the attenuators as 'Three Bipolar Voltage Controlled Amplifiers (VCA)'; the module text calls them inverting attenuators.
The Mod Sources line in the specifications lists S/H as a waveform; on the panel S/H is a separate output.
CLOCK OUT is labelled 'CV INPUT: 0V to 10V' in its own description, though it is an output.
Amp EG ENV END OUT is a 'GATE OUTPUT: 0V to +8V'; the filter EG's is 'CV OUTPUT: 0V to +5V'.

modelling_gaps.detail: About 50 global settings exist; the main performance and routing ones are modelled, the rest are listed by name in the manual's tables.
Four bidirectional parallel jacks per mult are modelled as one input and three outputs.
Pitch and cutoff input chains are small selector modules; the selection rule is a behaviour.
